metadata.title: Toolops features in MCP context forge
metadata.author: Jay-IRL

description: # 📝 Pull Request Draft for Toolops features # ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR Adding toolops features to MCP context forge --- ## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences) This PR integrates several toolops features such as tool test case generation , tool description enrichment and test case execution with an agent. Toolops features are part of agent life cycle toolkit(ALTK) library and this PR integrates necessary components from ALTK in to MCP-CF --- ## 🧪 Checks - [x] `make black, make isort , make pylint , make flake8 , make lint-web, make doctest , make interrogate` are passing. - [x] `make test` passes - [ ] CHANGELOG updated (if user-facing) --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) - For enabling `Toolops` features , TOOLOPS_ENABLED=true is set in .env file - Toolops related dependencies set-up is described in `./mcpgateway/toolops/README.md` - Toolops features are added as endpoints to the `Toolops` router at http://localhost:4444/docs - Toolops Tab is added in UI to support different features such as generate test cases , enrich , validate test cases

reviews.author: kevalmahajan
